name: npc_saints-greeter
customDialogue:
Welcome to the Saints HQ. Food bank downstairs, the gym on two, study rooms up top.
Everybody eats here. Everybody trains. Everybody learns.
Ask at the desk if you need anything.

name: npc_saints-mechanic
customDialogue:
Mind the lifts! That purple one is three coats of candy paint.
We fix anything with wheels. And some things without.

name: npc_saints-hooper
customDialogue: Next game is winners stay on. You got next?

name: interiorEntrance_sl_block_party
promptText: Press O to Enter the Block Party

interiorDefinition.title: The Block Party
interiorDefinition.description: Four bowling lanes, pool tables, the DJ booth under the neon, the disco ball.

hotspots.description: Every job the Saints take starts at this table. The halo over it lights up when the whole crew is in the room.
The whole of Los Angeles from one window. The Saints say they look after it; the city has never complained.
Lights over the court, the lowriders on show, the DJ on the decks, food for everybody, and one line underlined twice: EVERYBODY DANCES.
Purple keys, gold lines, the halo at centre court. Weekend runs start at noon and end when the lights go off.
Every seat has been sat in by somebody's grandmother yelling at the referee.
Candy purple, gold leaf on the hood, hydraulics that can make it dance. It is never quite finished; that is the point.
Twelve coats of candy paint, each one sanded by hand. The hood in the booth is drying for the third day.
Top drawer, under the socket set: the good wrench, the one with the gold handle.
A quarter turn here, a tighten there. The engine coughs, rumbles, and starts to purr.
Ask the librarian anything about the city. If it is not in a book here, it is in the librarian.
Sunset over the boulevard, the palms, the cars. Painted by kids from the block one summer.
The Librarian stamps a brand new card with a little gold halo. Name: you. Expires: never.
Four lanes, glow-in-the-dark balls on Friday nights, and a scoreboard that cheers for strikes.
Two turntables, a crate of records and the biggest speakers on the block. The party starts when the needle drops.
Lane 4 by the DJ booth: ten frames, your best score kept.
You flip through the crate and pull out a record with a gold label. Across the room, the DJ nods: that one has a bounce.

spotConfig.label: Read the welcome sign
spotConfig.text: WELCOME TO SAINTS, LOS ANGELES. City of wings. Keep it clean, keep it loud, and if you can hoop, the court is yours. The Saints.

requires.hint: Higher. The HQ has a fire escape round the side.

spotConfig.text: On the HQ roof the whole city opens up: the court, the arena with its gold wings, the hills sign far off. From up here the arena's wings line up with the HQ, as if the building could fly.
You walked all the way out of the city and up the hill. The letters of the sign are taller than the HQ, and somebody has signed their name on the back of the first one: a Saint, of course.
The purple lowrider bounces on its springs as you walk up. Once.
The gold lowrider bounces twice, chrome flashing.
The blue lowrider bounces three times and plays a little horn tune. That is all of them.

requires.hint: The court has a secret, but only after dark.

spotConfig.text: At night the court lights hum, and on the centre circle you can hear it: a ball bouncing, sneakers squeaking, a crowd that is not there. Somebody just hit a game winner.

requires.hint: Up. The apartments have a fire escape.

spotConfig.text: The apartment roof: a lawn chair, a radio, a pot of tomatoes and the best view of the street. Somebody up here watches every game on the court.

requires.hint: The wings shine best at sunset.

spotConfig.text: From here, at sunset, the arena's gold wings sit right behind you. Click. Every Saint has this picture.

spotConfig.label: Walk the street

requires.hint: Wait until the streetlights come on.

spotConfig.startText: All the way along the street, past every light, to the far corner.
spotConfig.failText: You left the street. Start again at the west corner.
spotConfig.text: The whole street, every light: each one flickered as you passed, like the street was saying hello. The far corner light stays on a little longer for you.

spotConfig.label: Look in the planter
spotConfig.text: Curled up in the planter between the flowers, a tiny Saints ant is asleep in the sun. It wakes up, stretches, and whispers something.

name: npc_saints-librarian
customDialogue:
The Librarian pushes up a pair of gold-rimmed glasses. Shh. Welcome.
Everything in here is free. The books, the computers, the air conditioning.
If it is not in a book, ask me. If it is not in me, we will find it together.

name: npc_saints-dj
customDialogue:
The DJ nods to a beat only they can hear. Arcade night, every Friday.
Lanes in the back, decks by the window, the speakers as big as the block allows.
The party starts when the needle drops.

name: npc_saints-shopkeeper
customDialogue:
The Shopkeeper polishes an orange on her apron. Fresh today, fresh tomorrow.
Half of what comes in goes to the food bank. That is how the block works.
Take a peach. Everybody takes a peach.

spotConfig.text: The court. Winners stay on, losers buy the lemonade. The Court Regular has been here since sunrise.
spotConfig.label: The court

spotConfig.text: The library. Free cards, free books, free air conditioning. The best deal in the city.
spotConfig.label: The library

spotConfig.text: The custom shop. Three lowriders, twelve coats of candy paint and one very tired mechanic.
spotConfig.label: The custom shop

spotConfig.text: The arena, gold wings all the way round. On game nights you can hear it from the hills.
spotConfig.label: The arena
Run the court
spotConfig.startText: Corner to corner, twelve seconds. GO! Hold R to run!
spotConfig.failText: Too slow. The Court Regular is yawning. Back to the cone and run it again.
spotConfig.text: Four corners, and you are back before the Court Regular finishes yawning.

spotConfig.label: Polish the lowrider
spotConfig.text: The purple paint comes up so deep you could swim in it.

spotConfig.label: Polish the lowrider
spotConfig.text: The gold leaf on the hood catches the sun and throws it right back.

spotConfig.label: Polish the lowrider
spotConfig.text: The blue lowrider gleams. You can see the HQ halo in the door.

spotConfig.label: Read the story of the block
holdLines: Chapter one: an empty lot, a basketball and a dream...
Chapter two: the first food bank, in a garage...
Chapter three: the block the Saints built.
spotConfig.text: You close the book. The block looks different now, in a good way.

spotConfig.label: Take the crate
spotConfig.text: Three boxes: oranges, greens and fresh bread. Heavy, but it smells amazing.

spotConfig.label: Drop off a box
spotConfig.text: The food bank volunteers cheer and stack the box with the others. Everybody eats.

spotConfig.label: Drop off a box
spotConfig.text: The Mechanic grabs an orange before the box even touches the ground.

spotConfig.label: Drop off a box
spotConfig.text: You leave the box by the apartment doors. A small hand reaches out and takes the bread first.

spotConfig.label: Deliver the package

requires.hint: Up. The apartments have a fire escape.

spotConfig.text: Grandma Lupe takes the package, squints at you and hands you a tomato. The highest honour on the block.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mural
spotConfig.text: An angel with a halo of sunflowers, painted the summer the library opened.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mural
spotConfig.text: This angel is holding a game controller. The kids voted on it.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mural
spotConfig.text: Gold wings either side of the bays, so every car drives out with wings.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mural
spotConfig.text: Angels and wings all round the arena. On this one, the kids signed their names along the bottom.

spotConfig.label: Fix the streetlight
spotConfig.text: Bzzt. A loose wire, tightened. The light steadies.

spotConfig.label: Fix the streetlight
spotConfig.text: The front light hums and comes on clean.

spotConfig.label: Fix the streetlight
spotConfig.text: The light by the HQ steps blinks twice and stays on. Good as new.

spotConfig.label: Water the palm
spotConfig.text: The palm drinks it all and asks for more.

spotConfig.label: Water the palm
spotConfig.text: Glug, glug. The fronds lift a little.

spotConfig.label: Water the palm
spotConfig.text: This one has been waiting a long time. It looks grateful. For a palm.

spotConfig.label: Water the palm
spotConfig.text: Slow and steady. The soil darkens round the trunk.

spotConfig.label: Water the palm
spotConfig.text: The last palm. A hummingbird drops by to see what the fuss is about.

spotConfig.label: Start the hike
spotConfig.startText: Follow the trail flags up into the hills. Take your time.
spotConfig.failText: You wandered off the trail. Back to the start flag on the north street.
spotConfig.text: The trail ends below the sign. Find the best spot for a picture.

spotConfig.label: Take a picture
spotConfig.text: Click. You, the sign, the city and the block, all in one picture.
spotConfig.photo: Saints of LA · the hills sign

requires.hint: Higher. The HQ has a fire escape round the west side.

spotConfig.text: From the HQ roof you count the tower windows on the hills: four hundred and twelve, give or take a pigeon.

spotConfig.label: Start the patrol
spotConfig.startText: Corner to corner, the whole block. Take your time.
spotConfig.failText: You wandered off the patrol. Back to the cone by the gate.
spotConfig.text: Round the block and back. Quiet streets, friendly waves.

spotConfig.label: Shoot free throws
spotConfig.text: Five in a row. The Court Regular drops the ball and just points at you.

spotConfig.label: Repaint the crosswalk
spotConfig.text: The south-west crosswalk is bright white again.

spotConfig.label: Repaint the crosswalk
spotConfig.text: Fresh stripes at the south-east corner. A driver honks: thanks.

spotConfig.label: Repaint the crosswalk
spotConfig.text: The north-east crosswalk, done. A kid on a scooter tests it immediately.

spotConfig.label: Repaint the crosswalk
spotConfig.text: The last crosswalk. The whole block is safe to cross again.

spotConfig.label: Switch on the party lights
spotConfig.text: The lights snake on over the court, pole to pole. As if on cue, the sun starts to set behind the hills.

skill.title: Switch on the party lights
skill.startText: Throw each breaker when the marker is in the gold.

spotConfig.label: Dance with the block
holdLines: The DJ drops the needle. The whole block cheers.
The Court Regular busts out a spin move.
The Mechanic and the Shopkeeper do the robot. Badly.
Somewhere up high, Grandma Lupe is dancing on the apartment roof.
spotConfig.text: The whole block dances on the court until the stars come out.

riddles.q: I have a spine but no bones, leaves but no branches, and I tell stories without a mouth. What am I?
riddles.why: The pages are leaves, the spine holds them, and the stories are inside.

riddles.q: The day before yesterday the DJ was 17. Next year they will be 20. How can that be?
a: Today is New Year's Day, and their birthday is New Year's Eve
riddles.why: On 30 December they were 17. They turned 18 on the 31st, they turn 19 this December and 20 the next.

riddles.q: How many times can you subtract 5 from 25?
riddles.why: Once. After that you are subtracting from 20.

riddles.q: Which word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
Three switches in the garage; one of them lights the lamp on the HQ roof. You may climb up only once. How do you tell which switch it is?
a: Flip them one at a time and shout
Turn one on for a while, turn it off, turn another on, then climb up and feel the bulb
riddles.why: Lit: the second switch. Dark but warm: the first. Dark and cold: the one you never touched.

game.title: Downtown Sprint
game.text: Round the whole block, then up the steps to the HQ
